relations: 伴侣（群落）：Kayla 与四个男人——她认定自己身后有人，并说从未想过会和四个男人有这种关系。原文："I have these men at my back no matter what I do, even if they don't agree with me." / "It is something I never thought I would have in a relationship with one man, let alone four."（数字 four）
伴侣/信任：Ares 与 Kayla——Ares 要她无条件信任他，Kayla 说自己相信他会处理 Aaron 的事。原文："Ares asked me to trust him" / "I actually believe Ares when he says he will handle it."
伴侣：Vero 与 Kayla——她说不怕他碰她，并说感激自己的过去把她带到他身边。原文："I will always want you to touch me." / "I'm grateful my life led me here."

亲属：Kayla 与她的父母——她讲十五岁时偷养狗被母亲过敏、被父亲背锅的旧事。原文："I wanted a pet so badly, but I hadn't thought it through. My mom is allergic to pet hair and started sneezing. She blamed my father until they found out there was a dog in my room."（数字 fifteen）

敌对：Vero 与 Kayla 对 Aaron——Vero 承认用纸割想让账，却数不清割了多少，并承认抵不掉 Aaron 做过的事；Aaron 自出狱起就在策划。原文："I wanted to make it even with what he did to you." / "how many paper cuts it takes to kill a man" / "Aaron was planning this since he was released from prison."

facts.fact: Kayla 跟 Ares 骑车回岛，努力不去想警察已经知道 Aaron 失踪的事，那件事像水泥块一样压在她胸口。
facts.anchor: I try not to focus on the fact that the cops know Aaron is missing, but it sits heavy in my chest like a cement block.

facts.fact: Kayla 在后门台阶上发现异常平静的 Vero，他形容自己的状态是 Brawley 所说的「the in-between」。
facts.anchor: My brain has gone quiet but won’t switch off. Brawley calls it the in-between.

facts.fact: Vero 问 Kayla 棺材里是什么感觉——这是第一个直接这样问她的人；她描述黑暗、逼仄，以及木头同时压住两条胳膊。
facts.anchor: What was it like in the coffin?

facts.fact: Vero 说自己本该跟她一起去，Kayla 回答没人可能知道，并说 Aaron 自出狱起就在策划这件事，过错只在他。
facts.anchor: Nobody could have known. Aaron was planning this since he was released from prison. It’s no one’s fault but his.

facts.fact: Kayla 说出自己的恐慌发作是被 Aaron 在交往期间「训练」掉的；她说在棚屋里 Cipher 只是平静地说了出来，没人让她觉得自己蠢，而 Vero 是开口问、不是直接动手碰她。
facts.anchor: Aaron had trained me out of them while we were together, which sounds like a good thing, but it wasn’t.

facts.fact: Vero 承认自己曾想用纸割数量替 Kayla 找补、结果割到数不清，并承认那永远抵不掉 Aaron 做过的事。
facts.anchor: I wanted to make it even with what he did to you.

facts.fact: Kayla 说自己现在的感受是解脱而不是哀悼——终于结束了；她还说不因为他的过去而来到他身边而变成坏人。
facts.anchor: it’s almost a relief that it’s over. Really, finally over.

facts.fact: Brawley 向 Kayla 保证他们永远会护住她、无论各人之间红旗如何，他们都会有她的后盾；Kayla 由此决心不再放开他们。
facts.anchor: the one thing I can promise is that we will have your back.
